Fast, free VPN. One short ad a day, no ads during use, no account.

We do not log, collect or sell your browsing activity. All traffic, including DNS and IPv6, goes through the encrypted tunnel. Ads are shown by Google AdMob, which may use an advertising ID if you consent.

Locations marked COMMUNITY are run by volunteers of the VPN Gate academic project (University of Tsukuba). They are encrypted, but their operators may keep connection logs. Avoid sensitive logins on them; use VERIFIED locations when available.
Volta uses the OpenVPN for Android engine by Arne Schwabe (GPLv2). Volta\'s source code is published under the same license.
